parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of abstract model fields comparing equal across models by modifying the __eq__, __lt__, and __hash__ methods. The changes are minimal and focused on the intended fix.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new attribute access (`self.model._meta.app_label` and `self.model._meta.model_name`) which may not be consistent with the project's style or conventions.
The patch could be slightly more readable with additional comments explaining the changes to the comparison logic.
